counter_semantics.allocation_statistics: Separate atomic module-lifetime observations fed by actual supported-allocator attempt/failure sites; no ordinary AbiStatistics or live binding arrays read
counter_semantics.cached_service_counters: FirstTxn seal cache; may never have been sampled on failure
counter_semantics.entry_rejections: Atomic saturating module-lifetime count; invalid-state entries do not inspect request geometry
counter_semantics.first_failure: Single 0→1 reservation winner writes immutable stage/request/CPU scalar tuple then release-publishes2; getter acquire-loads state2 only
counter_semantics.fresh_service_counters: independent existing actual counter getters; no seal cache mutation
counter_semantics.independent_sampling: Counter values sampled independently; no coherent cross-counter invariant claimed

getter_guard: Actual ordinary thread; pure FirstTxnGetSnapshot exact nv; actual current thread equals master; originalReturned and not originalInFlight
logging_boundary: after actual original wrapper returned with unchanged nonzero status
